profile.name: Zaber 菊花链式电动位移台与光学外设系统
profile.name_en: Zaber daisy-chained motorized stage and optical peripheral system
profile.description: 这是一类通过串口菊花链连接的 Zaber 实验室自动化设备系统，可包含电动位移台、滤光轮或滤块转塔，以及 LED 光源控制器。它常用于显微镜和光学实验中，实现样品定位、滤光片切换和照明控制等自动化操作。
profile.description_en: This is a family of Zaber laboratory automation devices connected over a serial daisy chain, including motorized stages, filter wheels or filter cube turrets, and LED light controllers. It is commonly used in microscopy and optical experiments for automated sample positioning, filter switching, and illumination control.
